The '''Wedding of [[Garik Loran]] and [[Dia Passik]]''' was a ceremony that took place sometime after [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. [[Voort saBinring]], one of their former teammates from [[Wraith Squadron]], was known to have attended the event.<ref name="MK" />
